lines.en: Would you like to learn about ocelots?
lines.zh: 想了解豹猫吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说什么？

lines.en: : {i}Hi, Kaori. Please tell me more about your newest friend.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗨，Kaori。请再给我讲讲你最新的朋友。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}hello friend this new friend isn't my friend but it's still a friend and the friend is called the leopardus pardalis or ocelot and its a mammal{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你好朋友 这个新朋友不是我的朋友 但它也算朋友 这个朋友叫作 leopardus pardalis 或者豹猫 它是哺乳动物{/i}

lines.en: : {i}it's also a cat but you can probably tell that part because of the cute face strings and cat-like catracteristics.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它也是猫 不过这你大概看得出来 因为那张可爱的脸纹和像猫一样的猫特征{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I see. But how can it be little and big at the same time?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这样啊。可它怎么能同时又小又大？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}it is two things at once because it's not a small cat but a big cat but it's small for a big cat and also big for a small cat do you get it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它同时是两样东西 因为它不是小猫 而是大猫 但它对大猫来说算小 对小猫来说又算大 你懂吗{/i}

lines.en: : {i}for the example this nyanfriend can grow up to 39 inches and 35 lbs that's almost 1 pound for every inch isn't that crazy it's so big small{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}比如说 这位喵朋友能长到 39 英寸、35 磅 差不多每英寸就有 1 磅 是不是很疯狂 它又大又小{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I guess that is a little crazy, yeah. What else can you tell me about ocelots?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是挺疯狂的，嗯。关于豹猫你还能告诉我些什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}everything i know a lot and this cat in particular because it's my favorite cat and also nocturnal which means it's sleep in the sun and enjoys the moonball{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我全都知道 我知道很多 尤其是这只猫 因为它是我最喜欢的猫 而且它是夜行性的 意思是它在太阳下睡觉 享受月亮球{/i}

lines.en: : {i}when it goes out in the dark it finds slimy and feathery and furry creatures to eat because the ocelot isn't picky just very hungry and very in the dark{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它在黑暗中出门 去找黏糊糊的、长羽毛的和毛茸茸的生物来吃 因为豹猫不挑食 只是很饿 而且很在黑暗里{/i}

lines.en: : {i}but it is also normally lonely because it likes alone time unless babies happen then they can come too{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但它通常也很孤独 因为它喜欢独处 除非有了宝宝 那宝宝们就可以一起来{/i}

lines.en: : {i}oh i also forgot to mention the wood things in the ground make the ocelot happy because they climb but do you remember what the wood things are called friend i don't{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦 我还忘了说 地上那些木头东西会让豹猫很开心 因为它们会爬 不过朋友你还记得那些木头东西叫什么吗 我不记得了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Trees?{/i}
: {i}yes those the ocelot likes them it likes to climb can you climb friend we should climb a tree together i bet you're good at it your hands are so big{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对 就是那些 豹猫喜欢它们 它喜欢爬 朋友你会爬吗 我们应该一起爬树 我打赌你很擅长 你的手那么大{/i}

lines.en: : {i}but then again the nyanfriend in the picture has no hands just claws and that makes the climb easy i wish we had claws that would be fun{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过话又说回来 图片里这位喵朋友没有手 只有爪子 这样爬起来就轻松了 真希望我们也有爪子 那一定很好玩{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, same. Thanks again for teaching me all of this, Kaori. I really appreciate it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，同感。再次谢谢你教我这些，Kaori。我真的很感激。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}wait i have more facts to tell you so you can know more facts{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等等 我还有更多知识要告诉你 这样你就能知道更多知识{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh, sorry.{/i}
: {i}the ocelot lives in many places but never chile so you have to remember that if you go to chile you won't find any ocelots{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}豹猫生活在很多地方 但从来不在智利 所以你得记住 要是你去了智利 你一只豹猫都找不到{/i}

lines.en: : {i}and since the ocelot is a cat it's like the other cats and can make ocespring happen as early as fifteen months imagine being a mothermom that young wow glad i'm not a cat{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且因为豹猫是猫 它跟别的猫一样 最早十五个月大就能有小猫宝宝 想想看那么小就当妈妈 哇 还好我不是猫{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I think you'd make a good cat, Kaori.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得你会是只很棒的猫，Kaori。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}nyaaaaaaan{/i}
: {i}i did it i made the cat noise but i did it with letters so there was no sound and now i am just sadness{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我做到了 我发出了猫叫 但我是用字母发出的 所以没有声音 现在我只剩下悲伤{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, you can meow for me in person the next time I see you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那下次见面你可以当面给我喵一声。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}okay and then we can climb a tree goodbye friend i will practice my cat noises and jumping i have been jumping a lot lately it's very fun{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好的 然后我们还能一起爬树 再见朋友 我会练习我的猫叫和跳跃 我最近跳得可多了 非常好玩{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm sure it is, Kaori. I'll talk to you later.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我相信是，Kaori。回头聊。{/i}
